Error mostly from fp32 rounding ~1e-7. Probably OK. Real risk: mid-range accuracy of truncated coefficients. 1. Mid-range values (0.66<|x|<=1) where reduced=(|x|-1)/(|x|+1) and polynomial in fp32: error may exceed 1e-6 — probe dense grid of all FP16 values in [0.6,2.5] and near 65504.
